verses.en: I will lift up mine eyes unto the hills, from whence cometh my help.
verses.pt: Elevo os meus olhos para os montes; de onde me vem o socorro?
verses.en_web: I will lift up my eyes to the hills. Where does my help come from?
verses.en_bbe: <A Song of the going up.> My eyes are lifted up to the hills: O where will my help come from?

verses.en: My help cometh from the LORD, which made heaven and earth.
verses.pt: O meu socorro vem do Senhor, que fez os céus e a terra.
verses.en_web: My help comes from Yahweh, who made heaven and earth.
verses.en_bbe: Your help comes from the Lord, who made heaven and earth.

verses.en: He will not suffer thy foot to be moved: he that keepeth thee will not slumber.
verses.pt: Não deixará vacilar o teu pé; aquele que te guarda não dormitará.
verses.en_web: He will not allow your foot to be moved. He who keeps you will not slumber.
verses.en_bbe: May he not let your foot be moved: no need of sleep has he who keeps you.

verses.en: Behold, he that keepeth Israel shall neither slumber nor sleep.
verses.pt: Eis que não dormitará nem dormirá aquele que guarda a Israel.
verses.en_web: Behold, he who keeps Israel will neither slumber nor sleep.
verses.en_bbe: See, the eyes of Israel's keeper will not be shut in sleep.

verses.en: The LORD is thy keeper: the LORD is thy shade upon thy right hand.
verses.pt: O Senhor é quem te guarda; o Senhor é a tua sombra à tua mão direita.
verses.en_web: Yahweh is your keeper. Yahweh is your shade on your right hand.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord is your keeper; the Lord is your shade on your right hand.

verses.en: The sun shall not smite thee by day, nor the moon by night.
verses.pt: De dia o sol não te ferirá, nem a lua de noite.
verses.en_web: The sun will not harm you by day, nor the moon by night.
verses.en_bbe: You will not be touched by the sun in the day, or by the moon at night.

verses.en: The LORD shall preserve thee from all evil: he shall preserve thy soul.
verses.pt: O Senhor te guardará de todo o mal; ele guardará a tua vida.
verses.en_web: Yahweh will keep you from all evil. He will keep your soul.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord will keep you safe from all evil; he will take care of your soul.

verses.en: The LORD shall preserve thy going out and thy coming in from this time forth, and even for evermore.
verses.pt: O Senhor guardará a tua saída e a tua entrada, desde agora e para sempre.
verses.en_web: Yahweh will keep your going out and your coming in, from this time forward, and forever more.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord will keep watch over your going out and your coming in, from this time and for ever.
